core_claim: Validity gating removes undefined TTA from control, but bounded symmetric TTA and fallback have not shown universal ranking gains on the reused auxiliary sample.

panels.TTA_extremes: Full historical ungated relative maximum versus strictly pair-valid relative, symmetric and log scores; these are different numerical domains, explicitly labelled.
panels.ranking_metrics: All five methods on the same full valid-GT error population, three frames in one previously observed sequence; no blind-test claim.
panels.paired_common_domain: Common valid-pair diagnostic plotted separately from full-GT rejection policy, never recast as the failed strict gate passing.
panels.risk_coverage: All five curves and common oracle; same frozen errors and all original zero predictions retained in the full-GT population.
panels.validity_plates: Original RGB, invalid-native/pair masks, bounded disagreement and continuous risks, undefined fields explicitly grey. No dense VIPER GT or accuracy labels.
panels.window_admission: Twenty frozen windows and camera-motion descriptors selected without algorithm outcomes, not inference results.

statistics: Frame macro mean with three individual frame points, one reused evaluation sequence; no pixel-IID error bars or independent-generalization CI.
canvas: white report figures, editable SVG/PDF text
integrity: Map contrast/ranges shared across images, display clipping labelled, numerical arrays unmodified, no algorithm outcome used for selection.

R3_contract.core_conclusion: Compare actual paired VO utility, failure and cost on all20 fixed sequences without presuming an improved method.
R3_contract.source: evaluation CSVs plus original trajectory NPZ only
R3_contract.statistics: One window per source sequence, seed43;3000 sequence-bootstrap mean intervals, exploratory; no pixel/BA event independent-n claim.
R3_contract.pairing: A0 installed native and A1 candidateD1 separately; exact N and failures kept.
R3_contract.scale: Raw path ratio and SE3 separate from one-global-Sim3 shape.
R3_contract.export: PNG previews with editable SVG/PDF, report size; no final-journal-spec claim.
R3_contract.partial_render: NA for unexecuted denominators; regenerate all figures after140 terminal outcomes.
